name: Medicaid pending without a verified eligibility date
legal_basis: SEED EXAMPLE, not a real rule. Payer source is a protected input (Section 1557 §92.210 exposure, dev-alignment 2.8); shown here only to exercise the structured legal_reviewer guard. Routes to financial_status, never to the clinical outcome (SPEC §4).
expression: payer_medicaid_pending is yes AND payer_eligibility_verified is no
exceptions: SYNTHETIC: a facility with a Medicaid-pending bed hold agreement may disable this rule.
explanation: Medicaid is listed as pending and no eligibility verification is documented.
next_action: Request the eligibility verification from the liaison; the clinical answer is not affected.
